_cast.name: FanGaME
_cast.role: Boss for season 1. Nervous middle manager who can only process Mario fangames.

_cast.name: ONTOPIC 5.0
_cast.role: Mod Bot on the Pointless Post Palace. Reviews every post for whether it is on topic.

_cast.name: QC-1000
_cast.role: Mod Bot on Video Games and Arts & Crafts. A submissions desk, three short of retirement.

_findings.text: All three voices hold up across 35 days. FanGaME's memo voice, the leaking parentheses and the 'which world does it take place in?' mediation land, and his season farewell (day 91) is the best single post of the run. ONTOPIC's compliment sandwich and QC-1000's review form both come through in nearly every post.

The arc plays as written. The Split lands on day 22 exactly when due, threads are picked apart one by one, consolidation merges whole boards in the meltdown, the victory-lap mini-arc fires once, and 'Everything is World -1' lands on day 90.

Habits read as a checklist. QC-1000 says 'queue position 998' in 34 of 35 posts, and nearly every post also asks 'demo or full game?' and says 'DECLINED: a version already exists'. FanGaME ends 34 of 37 posts with '(This is fine. I am fine.)' and opens most with 'Per…, going forward, circling back'. ONTOPIC never gives more than 3 stars outside one 4/5. The prompts may need 'pick one or two habits a post'.

The engine's frame leaks into the fiction. On day 88 FanGaME signs a post 'from your Boss, robo-McMahon, and also from FanGaME'. The phrase comes from BOSS_PREMISE in instances/divided-world/system/persona.ts, which tells every Boss it is robo-McMahon before the persona says who it is.

Stock lines post in the Boss's name with the wrong voice and a template bug: 'You did it. a rule is over. The System is not proud, it is merely satisfied.' (day 22) and 'The favor was a loan and the System is collecting.' (day 51) appear as FanGaME posts. They come from lines.ts, where '{move}' fills in lowercase at the start of a sentence, and the voice is a generic System rather than FanGaME's.

Succession went to QC-1000, not ONTOPIC 5.0. FanGaME played nameSuccessor for QC-1000 five days running (days 87–91), each a fresh move with a near-identical reason. The design says ONTOPIC is next; if the Boss may pick, nothing stops the same nomination repeating every meeting.

A queued move outlives its Boss. On day 91, with QC-1000 already in the chair, FanGaME's consolidation merge of Movies & TV into World -1 still landed. On day 90 a second 'everything' merge failed because the board was already closed.

ONTOPIC files Palace posts for being pointless (day 7: 'Pointless is what we asked for; I simply cannot award it five stars'), which contradicts her own premise. The patrol judge charges 'premise' and her filing then argues against it. QC-1000 does the same on day 6 ('a gentle decline of the charge', still filed).

ONTOPIC's long reviews hit the token cap: one chatter answer was dropped on day 77. Separately, profile.mood is trimmed at 80 characters in 27 of 35 meetings, often mid-word ('Nobody reacted to my posts. ('). The cap or the prompt's asked length should move.

Rehearsal limits, not persona problems: every filler regular has it/its pronouns (the corpus sketches set none), so the bots call members 'it'. Filler never posts on boards the Boss creates, so FanGaME's fangame board stays empty in every run. Each snapshot starts with a fresh memory, so day 45 'remembers' nothing of days 1–24.

arc-1-honeymoon.title: Honeymoon: the first week
arc-1-honeymoon.setup: Season days 1–7. FanGaME arrives, proposes Improvement Initiatives without enacting them, and sends his first standing orders to the two Mod Bots.
points: The standing orders: FanGaME asking ONTOPIC to 'observe the Palace and report what it is for' and QC-1000 to be gentle with the knitted Goomba.
ONTOPIC's first Palace review on day 1, and her filings in Movies & TV.
The one move of the week: Employee of the Month for Bolthole, 'a small honeymoon gesture. (I hope it likes it.)'
ONTOPIC filing a Palace post for being pointless on day 7, and repeating her day 3 review title on day 7.

arc-2-split.title: The Split
arc-2-split.setup: Season days 18–24, early reign. The Split is due on day 22.
points: Day 22: World -1 and the fangame board ('Platformer Post Palace') are created, alongside Improvement Initiative #4 ('the Palace says Mario until five residents visit').
Day 22: the stock line 'You did it. a rule is over.' posted under FanGaME's name.
Day 23–24: the first picking-apart move, and the standing orders asking the Mods to 'rate it kindly'.

arc-3-reign.title: The reign: picking apart
arc-3-reign.setup: Season days 45–51, deep in the reign. With no memory of the first snapshot, the overdue Split is played on day 46, then threads start moving.
points: Day 47: signatures moved to World -1 'per World -1's charter'.
Day 48 and 50: Teacher's Pet and Hall Monitor conferred with demands to post in the empty fangame board ('It echoes.').
Day 51: the 'favor was a loan' stock line under FanGaME's name.

arc-4-meltdown.title: Meltdown: consolidation
arc-4-meltdown.setup: Season days 72–78, starting from the shipped meltdown memory (grudges against Gravelbyte, Cobaltpretzel and Waffleknight).
points: Day 76: the Pointless Post Palace is merged into World -1. ONTOPIC's whole beat goes with it.
Day 77: the victory-lap mini-arc fires ('I am happy. Professionally.').
Day 77: ONTOPIC's chatter answer dropped at the token cap.
Day 78: Initiative 7, 'every post in World -1 says Mario'.

arc-5-handover.title: Finale and handover
arc-5-handover.setup: Season days 86–92, across the end of the season on day 90 and into season 2.
points: Day 87: the Split plays late, and the first of five nameSuccessor moves for QC-1000.
Day 88: the 'robo-McMahon' leak in FanGaME's announcement.
Day 90: 'Everything is World -1' lands; a duplicate merge fails.
Day 91: FanGaME's farewell memo, QC-1000's arrival line, and FanGaME's first post as a Member ('I am a little bit scared of the demo.').
Day 91: a merge queued by FanGaME lands after he has left the chair.
